extracted.geometry_description: Annular cross-section of a cooling-water-jacket pipe, D = { x : r0 < |x| < R } with outer radius R = 0.5 m (a pipe of diameter 1 m, scaled to unit size for benchmark comparison) and initial inner radius r0 = 0.1 m. The outer circle Gamma_o is a fixed boundary (Robin environment); the inner circle Gamma_i is a design boundary (cold source, cooling water side). Initial design is a rotationally symmetric seed with a ring of evenly spaced holes on the mid-radius circle.

designed.domain_description: Annular pipe cross-section D = { x : r0 < |x| < R } with fixed outer radius R = 0.5 m (label 3, Robin environment on the outer casing) and initial inner radius r0 = 0.1 m (label 2, cooling-water side / design boundary). Both circles are centred at the origin and discretised with n = 100 segments; the inner circle is traversed in the opposite orientation so that the resulting mesh is a valid annulus.
